warnings.why: A prevalence of 10.5% for anemia among women of reproductive age is implausibly low for Guatemala, given regional health surveys and socioeconomic context, where stunting and micronutrient deficiencies including anemia are historically much higher.
A prevalence of 12% is unusually low compared to official national nutrition surveys in the Philippines, which typically report higher rates of anemia among women of reproductive age.
